content:
“That'll wake you up in the mornin'!”

**Quack Surgeon** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Revive other players with liquor! This perk gives players the option to revive others with different kinds of liquor instead of stimpaks. The liquor will be selected at random. The button prompt will use the Reload button.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Revive other players with liquor! | 0012879F | 

You may revive allies by using the following liquor:

- ¹ Fermentable and vintage variants may be used by Quack Surgeon.

- Although it is a liquor, Nukashine and its variants cannot be utilized by Quack Surgeon.

- Although White Russian and Hard lemonade are crafted using vodka, they are missing the *DrinkTypeLiquor* keyword required to work with Quack Surgeon. **[patched]** 
- Although Sweetwater Special Blend is crafted using bourbon, it is missing the *DrinkTypeLiquor* keyword required to work with Quack Surgeon. **[patched]**
